items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, role, phase, checklist, evidence target, risks, and unknown state.
items.evidenceTarget: The roadmap record identifies Project Control ownership before writing a frontend roadmap.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap, owner repo-project-control, active role planning-partner, phase target phase-flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap-v1, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap-v1, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap-2026-09-03.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard before adding the roadmap records.
items.evidenceTarget: A focused test fails before Project Control contains the frontend roadmap Work, document, checklist, and evidence records.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because flowdoc-product-development-resumption did not yet include flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap as a child Work.

items.label: Define the expert frontend north star without claiming implementation readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: The roadmap states the Library, Design, Preview, and Publish product direction and marks the design artifact as non-truth.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap-2026-09-03.md defines the North Star and states that the design artifact is not product truth.

items.label: Map the frontend phases from product map through WYSIWYG gate decision.
items.evidenceTarget: The roadmap names each frontend phase, lane ID, expected output, and acceptance boundary.
items.verificationNote: The roadmap defines seven lanes: product map, design workspace usability, progressive authoring, preview confidence, publish flow binding, polish and accessibility, and WYSIWYG gate decision.

items.label: Define the first lane sequence before opening implementation rooms.
items.evidenceTarget: The roadmap recommends which lane to run first and what must stay out of implementation.
items.verificationNote: The recommended sequence starts with lane-frontend-product-map as a Project Control lane before any Editor implementation lane.

items.label: Preserve frontend truth boundaries and planned state.
items.evidenceTarget: The roadmap does not promote frontend readiness, map truth, WYSIWYG readiness, publish readiness, or production readiness.
items.verificationNote: The roadmap explicitly keeps product repository behavior unchanged, keeps FlowDoc truthState planned, and blocks current-state wording for frontend readiness.

items.label: Verify Project Control records, generated read model, and checks.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused roadmap guard, generated read model, Project Control data validation, and full Project Control checks pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap.test.ts --maxWorkers=1, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
